sentences.text:
Shyam @ Shyam Mohan And Another vs State Of U.P. on 17
February, 2023
Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit

Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 92
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 7761 of 2023
Applicant :- Shyam @ Shyam Mohan And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Arvind Agrawal

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Sri Arun Kumar Vishwakarma, Advocate has put in appearance on behalf of informant by filing his Vakalatnama, which is taken on record.

Heard Sri Arvind Agrawal, learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State, Sri Arun Kumar Vishwakarma, learned counsel for the informant and perused the material on record.
Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that the applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.
The F.I.R. was lodged against six accused persons including the applicants, who are brother-in-law of the deceased, with general allegations.

The co-accused Mukesh, who is also brother-in-law of the deceased, has already been granted bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 2.2.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.114 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.114 of 2023

sentences.text: The role assigned to the applicants is identical and similar to the role assigned to co-accused Mukesh, who has been granted bail by this Court and as such the applicants are also entitled for bail on the ground of parity.
There is no possibility of applicants of fleeing away from the judicial process or tampering with the prosecution evidence.

He next submits that the applicants have no criminal history and are in jail since 5.10.2022 and if released on bail, they will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned AGA for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant vehemently opposed the prayer of bail.

Upon hearing the learned counsel for the parties and upon the perusal of the record and considering the complicity of accused, severity of punishment as well as totality of facts and circumstances, at this stage, without commenting on the merits of the case, I find it a fit case for bail.

Let applicants- Shyam alias Shyam Mohan and Akshay Yadav be released on bail in Case Crime No.
293 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 302, 201 IPC, registered at P.S. Makkhanpur, District Firozabad,
on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicants will not tamper with prosecution evidence in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicants will abide by the orders of the court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicants will not indulge in any unlawful activity.
(iv) The applicants will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicants to prison.

Order Date :- 17.2.2023 Kpy  Shyam @ Shyam Mohan And Another vs State Of U.P. on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58985030/
